court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
respondents: Punjab National Bank Rep. by its Chief Manager and Another
advocates: For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.L. Ganesh for R 1
judgment_text:
PRAYER : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the 1st respondent bank to accept the E-auction payment of Rs 9,50,00,000 along with interest and to set aside the E-Auction sale proceedings conducted on 29-4-2025 by considering petitioner representation dated 9-3-2026 within a stipulated time as fixed by this Hon'ble Court.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petition.

2. The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
